title: Offboard a departing physician
trigger: A physician gives notice of departure.

roles.name: Departing physician
does: confirms personal workflow quirks are captured

steps.action: Freeze the physician's scheduling template for future dates and identify all pre-booked appointments.
Run the capture checklist against the physician's known processes before the last clinical day, not after.
Identify patients requiring transfer and the receiving physician for each.
Transfer or revoke EMR and provincial viewer access on the last day, and record the date of each change.
Confirm the billing run is complete and any outstanding claims are assigned to someone who will follow them up.
Confirm acceptance of transferred patients and take over the referral queue.

decisions.question: Where do unaccepted patient transfers go?

branches.then: Record the acceptance in the EMR and notify the patient.

branches.when: No physician has accepted by two weeks before the last day

exceptions.then: UNRESOLVED — there is no agreed emergency procedure. See gaps.

outputs: All patients transferred or an explicit escalation list
verification: Access revocation confirmed against the access log
Patient transfer list signed off by the clinic manager
Outstanding claims assigned to a named person

provenance.ref: "Last time we did this in the final week and nobody knew half of what he did."
"He knows which patients are his; it's not always clean in the system."
"Claims can trail for a month after someone leaves."

gaps.issue: No agreed definition of 'the physician's patient' when the EMR assignment and reality disagree.
No procedure for transfers nobody accepts; currently resolved ad hoc.
No emergency offboarding procedure exists at all.
Unclear whether provincial viewer access can be revoked same-day or requires a request to the authority.
